message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal public holidays that create “long weekends” in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you’re planning trips in a specific province, you’ll want to add that province’s own holidays—most of which also fall on a Friday or Monday and give a 3‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sun | Jan 1–2 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Observed on Monday Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, NB, PEI) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Mon | Feb 18–20 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Federal holiday in those provinces |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Fri | Apr 7–9 (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) | |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Mon | May 20–22 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Sat | Jul 1–3 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Observed on Monday Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Mon | Sep 2–4 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | Mon | Oct 7–9 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Saturday) | Sat | Nov 11–13 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Observed on Monday Nov 13 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Mon | Dec 23–25 (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tue | — | Not a long weekend |

### How to use this list
- **Plan a trip**: Pick any of the long‑weekend spans above for a 3‑day getaway.
- **Add provincial holidays**: If you’re in Ontario, for example, you’ll also have *St. Patrick’s Day* (Mar 17) and *Family Day* (Feb 20) as long weekends. Check your province’s holiday calendar for the full list.
- **Adjust for observed dates**: Some holidays that fall on a weekend are officially observed on the following Monday (e.g., Canada Day, Remembrance Day). Those observed Mondays are the ones that give you the extra day off.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like the same information broken down by province!
